phases.objective: Stop exploitation paths and prevent regression.
actions: Add regression tests for HIGH findings

phases.objective: Resolve HIGH/MEDIUM findings with smallest safe change.
exit_criteria: All HIGH findings transition to VERIFIED or DEFERRED

phases.objective: Prove fixes work and no regressions introduced.
actions: Run validation commands from each finding

patches.exact_intended_change: Wrap state transitions in await act(async () => ...) or use waitFor.
patches.expected_result: Finding transitions to VERIFIED; no regressions.
rollback: Revert changes for HQE-DEBT-001 and re-run validation.

patches.exact_intended_change: Translate missing theme strings or run node scripts/translate-missing.cjs --write and synchronize docs/i18n/translation-status.json.
patches.expected_result: Finding transitions to VERIFIED; no regressions.
rollback: Revert changes for HQE-DOC-001 and re-run validation.
